product: Partial-availability six-node monthly BM5 panel and six ETF prices
vendor: Derived from R1 contract data and current ETF proxy panel

source_inventory.criterion: Parent product panel and node mapping are recorded.

schema_keys_units.criterion: Node-date BM5 and ETF-date keys are unique.

date_axis_calendar.criterion: All signals occur on month-end and labels are next open.

coverage_universe.criterion: Partial node availability is explicit; ETF prelisting history is proxy-inclusive.
coverage_universe.reason: Meal and chemicals are unavailable before 2019/2021.

asof_available_at.criterion: C5 and BM5 use completed month-end data; ETF fills are next session.

revision_vintage.criterion: Historical release vintage must be available.
revision_vintage.reason: Public endpoints provide current revisions only.

historical_membership.criterion: Node membership is fixed and BM5 availability is determined from historical contract groups.

mapping_taxonomy.criterion: Futures groups map to six ETF nodes.

derived_lineage.criterion: Partial node BM5 and simulation code are deterministic.

reconciliation.criterion: Strict-six window reproduces R2; earlier proxy paths have no independent reconcile source.
reconciliation.reason: No independent historical ETF/futures total-return mapping.

reproducibility.criterion: Unit tests and exact strict-six replay pass.

pit.available_at_field: close for signal; next open for execution
tests: future input isolation inherited from R1

universe.historical_members: six fixed ETF nodes with availability-aware BM5
universe.survivorship_test: node fixed by strategy; product availability historical
